theory.title: Primer condicional y oraciones temporales
theory.explanation: Usa if + presente simple con will + infinitivo para expresar una posibilidad real futura. Después de when, as soon as, before y until se utiliza una forma de presente para referirse al futuro, no will.
theory.tip: If + presente simple, will + infinitivo. Tras when/as soon as/before/until, usa presente para hablar del futuro.

items.prompt: Describe something useful you have learned recently.
items.modelAnswer: I've recently learned to keep digital copies of important documents. I save them in clearly named folders, so I can find them quickly when I need them. It is a small habit that has already saved me time.

items.prompt: Explain how your daily routine has changed over time.
items.modelAnswer: My routine changed after I began working from home two days a week. I now start with a short walk and prepare a proper lunch instead of eating at my desk. I find it easier to concentrate.

items.prompt: Talk about a plan you have arranged for the near future.
items.modelAnswer: I've arranged to visit my parents next weekend. I have checked the train times and agreed to bring some food for Sunday lunch. We are hoping to spend the afternoon in the garden.

items.prompt: Explain what you will do if an important plan changes.
items.modelAnswer: If the plan changes, I will look for the most practical alternative and explain it to everyone. If the train is cancelled, I may travel by bus or postpone the visit. I won't wait until the last minute to tell them.

items.prompt: Report something someone told you recently.
items.modelAnswer: My manager told me that the office will be renovated in January. She said we might work from home for a few weeks and that the team would receive more information soon. I have started planning for that possibility.

items.prompt: Describe a skill you would like to develop and why.
items.modelAnswer: I would like to improve my ability to manage unexpected changes. I can organise a normal week quite well, but last-minute problems sometimes make me anxious. Practising different solutions could help me stay calm.

items.prompt: Talk about a past habit that you no longer have.
items.modelAnswer: I used to accept every invitation, even when I was tired. Now I check my plans before saying yes and sometimes choose to stay at home. I have learned that saying no politely is important.

items.prompt: Explain how you organise your time when you are busy.
items.modelAnswer: When I am busy, I decide which tasks have a deadline and which can wait. I tell people if I need more time and avoid starting several difficult jobs at once. Short breaks help me stay focused.

items.prompt: Describe an opportunity you are looking forward to.
items.modelAnswer: I'm looking forward to a local music event in the summer. If the weather is good, the concerts will take place outside. I've invited a friend, but we have agreed to decide nearer the date.

items.prompt: Give advice to someone starting a new course or job.
items.modelAnswer: At the beginning of a new course or job, find out what is expected during the first week. Keep track of deadlines and ask someone experienced for advice. Be patient with yourself while you learn.
